turn_splits.label: H
turn_splits.text: Good evening. Thank you for having us. I wanted to start this evening by just saying thank you very much for your collaboration and the partnership that we've had. Since the beginning of the pilot project for economic development. We are now in our 4th year, I believe. Our 5th year will be the end of 2025. And so we've been working quite focused on— the last time we were here, we were talking about our vision and that being centered around the excellence of building a center for excellence around advanced agribusiness. It's an ambitious vision that builds on our strengths as a city. Thank you. While preserving what makes us and this community very unique. More work has been done to execute on that vision and establishing a foundation as well for the organization in terms of putting together just the basics of, you know, what an organization needs in preparing us to be investment ready, without ignoring that businesses that are here and existing in Steinbach have a lot of importance and, and wanting to be a support to them as well. So for our agenda, I'm just gonna— there we go. So we're gonna talk to you about the said structure and what's been happening there. Okay. Michelle will talk to us about a bit, give you a bit of an update since we were here last June, I believe. And then we'll come back to myself just to talk about next steps and some of the projects that have been underway. Last week we had our first AGM, and I wanna thank Councillor Penner for being there as well as our mayor, Mayor Funk, as well as Troy. It was really important for you to be there and be part of, of the group, so I appreciate that. Our funding model and formalizing how we're going to work as an organization is important. And as we continue to bring the mandate of economic development forward, and we've become independent from this, from the Chamber of Commerce, created Steinbach Economic Development Corporation. Yes. And continue to widen the focus and broaden the focus from the chamber being a member-driven organization and now economic being— economic development being a little bit broader than that. So we are fully incorporated, and part of the motivation behind that was to access different levels of funding, including grants that are not accessible by the Chamber of Commerce. So now I'm going to pass it on to Michelle.
